# Vendored third-party code

These files are redistributed unmodified so the game runs from a bare static
server with no install step. Both are MIT licensed. The import map in
`index.html` is what binds the bare specifiers `three` and `three-mesh-bvh` to
them.

| File | Project | Version | Licence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `three.module.js` | [three.js](https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js) | r169 | MIT |
| `three-mesh-bvh.module.js` | [three-mesh-bvh](https://github.com/gkjohnson/three-mesh-bvh) | 0.8.3 | MIT |
